statement: Every lagrange.service.js is either normalized by one owner, src/service/service-source-contract.js, into an immutable IR whose route and operation identities come only from explicit object keys, or rejected with a named diagnostic per violation — duplicate route or operation id, route calling an undeclared operation, missing run or reduce, invalid identifier — and the frozen authoring descriptors from src/authoring import cleanly in a guest with no Node-only dependencies.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Identities derive only from descriptor object keys; any code path deriving identity from Function.name, HTTP path, SQL text, or array position is a defect.
Until the v2 ABI lands, an IR with more than one distributed operation is rejected with a named diagnostic; no tag-based multiplexing.
